mapper.select: select count(*) from delivery_information where delivery_location_no = #{delNo}
mapper.update: /* 배송지정보 수정 */ update delivery_list set delivery_nm = #{delNm}, primary_location = #{primaryLocation}, delivery_addr = #{delAddr}, delivery_daddr = #{delDaddr}, delivery_zip_no = #{delZipNo}, recipient_phone = #{recipientPhone}, delivery_request = #{delRequest}, revision_date = NOW() where delivery_location_no = #{delNo}

mapper.select: /* 고객 개인 배송지 목록 조회 */ select dl.delivery_location_no, dl.delivery_nm, dl.primary_location, dl.delivery_addr, dl.delivery_daddr, dl.delivery_zip_no, dl.recipient_phone, dl.delivery_request from delivery_list dl where dl.cust_id = #{custId} order by dl.primary_location
